en: A black and white image depicting a Renaissance-style stone palace with characteristic rusticated stonework and arched windows. The street scene shows period architecture with arched doorways and fashionable old European urban elements. There are few people visible and a sparse, quiet atmosphere typical of old city postcards. The lower border bears a printed caption.
